expectations.buyer: Small-business finance teams, owners, suppliers, banks, insurers, and accountants
expectations.pain: Fraudulent bank-detail changes exploit email and process gaps before payment
expectations.strongestIncumbent: Bank confirmation, call-back procedures, ERP vendor masters, payment controls, Verification of Payee, and cyber insurance guidance
expectations.biggestRisk: A procedure is cheap and incumbents own identity/payment rails; a tool cannot guarantee the supplier or account
